source.documentName: CISCE ICSE Regulations and Syllabuses - History and Civics (Code 50) & Geography (Code 50)

chapters.title: Our Constitution and Its Salient Features
chapters.description: Definition of Constitution, date of adoption and enforcement, Preamble (Sovereign, Socialist, Secular, Democratic, Republic, Justice, Liberty, Equality, Fraternity), and fundamental rights.

levels.title: The Preamble & Key Constitutional Concepts
levels.description: Historical background of the Constituent Assembly, Dr. B.R. Ambedkar, and key terms in the Preamble.

levels.title: Fundamental Rights & Writs
levels.description: Six Fundamental Rights (Articles 14 to 32) and the five constitutional writs.
subtopics: Right against Exploitation & Freedom of Religion
Habeas Corpus, Mandamus, Prohibition, Quo-Warranto, Certiorari

levels.title: Directive Principles & Fundamental Duties
levels.description: Socialist, Gandhian, and Liberal principles, and 11 Fundamental Duties under Article 51A.
subtopics: Difference between Fundamental Rights and Directive Principles

levels.title: Chapter 1 Review & Civics Mastery
levels.description: Review of Constitution, Rights, Writs, and Directive Principles.

units.title: History: Ancient Civilizations to Medieval India

chapters.title: The Harappan Civilization
chapters.description: Sources (Great Bath, Citadel, Seals, Bronze Dancing Girl, Dockyard at Lothal), town planning, drainage system, trade, and causes of decline.

levels.title: Town Planning & Architecture
levels.description: Grid system, burnt brick houses, Citadel, Great Granary, and the sanitary drainage system.
subtopics: The Great Bath structure and purpose

levels.title: Social, Economic Life & Seals
levels.description: Occupations, terracotta craft, Pashupati seal, Unicorn seal, weights and measures, and foreign trade.
subtopics: Trade with Mesopotamia and Lothal dockyard

levels.title: Decline of the Harappan Civilization
levels.description: Theories of Aryan invasion, floods, tectonic shifts, shifting of river courses, and deforestation.
subtopics: Mortimer Wheeler theory vs modern archaeological consensus

levels.title: Chapter 2 Review & Archaeological Evidence
levels.description: Picture study and structured questions on the Indus Valley Civilization.

chapters.title: Earth as a Planet & Structure of Earth
chapters.description: Shape of Earth (Oblate Spheroid / Geoid), proofs of earth's shape, internal structure (Crust, Mantle, Core), Mohorovicic and Gutenberg discontinuities.

levels.title: Shape & Size of the Earth
levels.description: Geoid shape, circumnavigation, ship on horizon, Bedford Level experiment, and circular shadow during lunar eclipse.
subtopics: Geoid concept and equatorial vs polar diameter

levels.title: Internal Structure: Crust, Mantle, Core
levels.description: SIAL and SIMA in the Lithosphere, Asthenosphere, Gutenberg & Moho discontinuities, NIFE core.
subtopics: Chemical composition of Crust (Si + Al, Si + Mg)
Core density, temperature, and magnetic field

levels.title: Chapter 3 Review & Earth Science Mastery
levels.description: Diagrams of interior of earth and physical geography reasoning.
